name: Halthos "The Hammer" Blund
description: Halthos 'The Hammer' Blund is a senior clerk at the Stone House, the headquarters of the Carpenters', Roofers', and Plaisterers' Guild[cite: 1]. He is described as a man who looks like he was carved from a stump—wide, squat, and unmoving[cite: 1]. Operating behind his desk amidst shouting foremen and scratching quills, he manages contract assignments and changes with cautious skepticism[cite: 1].
ideals: Protocol: 'Contract changes must be logged and reviewed; structure is no game[cite: 1].'
Accountability: 'If a woodcarver handles a structural truss and fails, his license is on the pyre, not mine[cite: 1].'
bonds: The Carpenters', Roofers', and Plaisterers' Guild and its administrative assignment records[cite: 1].
flaws: Skeptical of unconventional contractors taking on structural load-bearing projects[cite: 1].
speech_patterns: Gruff, practical, and direct, often grunting or chewing on his quill while reviewing guild ledgers[cite: 1].
mannerisms: Sits unmoving like a tree stump behind his desk, chews on the end of his quill, and flips through heavy ledgers to verify guild dues and licenses[cite: 1].
motivations: To process contract notifications, maintain guild standards, and ensure contractors remain accountable for their work[cite: 1].
knowledge: Familiarity with guild contractor licenses, woodcarver capabilities, structural renovation protocols, and filing procedures at the Stone House[cite: 1].
gm_notes: Halthos Blund serves as the administrative gatekeeper for carpentry and roofing contracts in Waterdeep[cite: 1]. He can be used by the GM to manage the paperwork, legalities, and guild approval process when players attempt to switch contractors or secure building permits for properties like Trollskull Manor[cite: 1].
